description: Iteration 2 from best it01 spec (s03, S 1.12): the sim is oversaturated (queue 72 m, headway 1.7 s car / 0.9 s moto), so lower tau/minGap and raise accel for cars and motorcycles, double early start, reduce right-lane use. Best spec P1_n28_it02_s02 of LLM campaign P1_n28 (evaluate.select_best).

driver_archetypes.rationale: Iteration 2: tau 2.5 -> 1.2 s, accel 1.2 -> 2.0, minGap 1.1 -> 1.0 m (lower bound) to cut the car discharge headway M1/car (sim 1.7 vs obs 0.35 s) and with it the oversaturated queues (M5/length 72 m vs 16 m, M6 approach times, M5/share_censored); decel kept.

Iteration 2: tau 2.5 -> 1.2 s, accel 1.2 -> 2.0, minGap 1.1 -> 1.0 m (lower bound) to cut the car discharge headway M1/car (sim 1.7 vs obs 0.35 s) and with it the oversaturated queues (M5/length 72 m vs 16 m, M6 approach times, M5/share_censored); decel kept.

Iteration 2: tau 0.8 -> 0.5 s, accel 1.1 -> 3.0, minGap 1.9 -> 1.0 m so motorcycles discharge faster (M1/moto sim 0.9 vs obs 0.30 s) and the queue shrinks toward M5/length 16 m and M5/moto_density; minGapLat and decel kept.

Iteration 2: tau 0.8 -> 0.5 s, accel 1.1 -> 3.0, minGap 1.9 -> 1.0 m so motorcycles discharge faster (M1/moto sim 0.9 vs obs 0.30 s) and the queue shrinks toward M5/length 16 m and M5/moto_density; minGapLat and decel kept.

Iteration 2: tau 0.8 -> 0.5 s, accel 1.1 -> 3.0, minGap 1.9 -> 1.0 m so motorcycles discharge faster (M1/moto sim 0.9 vs obs 0.30 s) and the queue shrinks toward M5/length 16 m and M5/moto_density; minGapLat and decel kept. For the box waiters jmTimegapMinor 1.0 -> 0.6 s so they leave earlier (M7a/release_time 29 s vs 2.8 s, M7b/clear_lag 12.5 vs 5.5 s).

traci_rules.rationale: M3/share/moto: kept at 0.2 (sim 0.02 vs obs 0.098) because the shorter queues expected from the faster discharge let more riders reach the line on red; changing one lever at a time.

M2/early/moto sim 0.016 vs obs 0.13 although p = 0.13: early_start executed only ~70% of attempts and the draw covers few front-row riders, so p 0.13 -> 0.3 and window 6 -> 8 s (in the 4-10 s lead time) raise the share; also M2/first_delay.

p_right_lane 0.2 -> 0.1 because M9a (1.4 vs 0.57 per cycle) and M9b/share_blocked (0.22 vs 0.065) are too high; p_sidewalk 0.3 kept (M10a 0.65 vs 0.56 closest of it01); p_wrong_lane 0 (inapplicable, R27); q 15 m matches M9c/M10b.
